item.title: Mandatory Water Conservation Issued for Parts of Schuylkill County as Drought Conditions Worsen
item.description: Aqua Pennsylvania has issued a mandatory water conservation notice for customers in parts of Schuylkill County as ongoing dry weather continues to strain regional water supplies. The notice applies to customers served by Aqua’s Roaring Creek Water Plant, including residents and businesses in Butler Township, Gordon Borough, and Girardville Borough. item.title: Battle of the Schuylkill County Dunkins? New Walmart Dunkin’ Opens in St. Clair
item.description: There’s a brewing rivalry in Schuylkill County that coffee lovers might not have expected. A new Dunkin’ location has officially opened inside the St. Clair Walmart, creating an unusual situation for the community, which has already been served by a Dunkin’ just outside the store for nearly two decades. item.title: PennDOT Driver License, Photo Centers to Close for Martin Luther King Jr. Day Holiday
item.description: The Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT) announced that all driver license and photo centers across the state will be closed for the Martin Luther King Jr. Day holiday weekend. PennDOT facilities, including the full-service driver license center in Harrisburg, will be closed from Saturday, January 17, through Monday, January 19, 2026. item.description: Kutztown University has announced that 2,261 students were named to its Fall 2025 Dean’s List including dozens from Schuylkill County.To qualify for the Dean’s List, an undergraduate student must be registered for at least 12 credit hours and earn a minimum grade point average of 3.60.
